name: Esper X Guide
source:
The world needs the spiritually gifted espers to fight off monsterous aberrations with their explosive  powers.

Espers need guides to purify their spirits from corrosive effects of using their abilities and return them to a state of equilibrium.

Guides need... a steady payout while pressed by the weight of corporatism where people are graded and discarded like commodities. 

Welcome to guideverse

[From [url=https://coffeedripstudios.itch.io/exg]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
世界需要具有精神天赋的超能者用他们的爆炸力来对抗怪物。

超能力者需要引导来净化他们的精神，使其免受使用能力的腐蚀影响，并使他们恢复到平衡状态。

导游需要……稳定的报酬，同时受到社团主义的压力，在社团主义中，人们像商品一样被分级和丢弃。

欢迎来到指南宇宙

[来自[url=https://coffeedripstudios.itch.io/exg]itch.io[/url]]
